title: Crispy Roti with Beef Suet Filling
description: A Malaysian-inspired dish featuring crispy roti bread filled with a savory beef suet mixture.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the beef suet and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the nice beef and cook until heated through.
Warm the roti pieces in the microwave or in a dry pan for a few seconds.
Place a piece of roti on a flat surface and spoon the beef suet mixture onto one half of the roti.
Fold the roti in half to enclose the filling.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in the pan over medium heat.
Add the folded roti and cook until the bottom is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the roti and cook for another minute, until the other side is also crispy.
